concept: Rows and columns of data in a real table with a caption, on a level-2 pane with an opaque header that stays in view.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a Table with a coloured header row, zebra stripes and vertical borders
default_to_avoid.why_not: a coloured header and stripes add hue and lines that compete with the data; Pane uses an opaque sheet-tone header and row hairlines

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the table is one level-2 pane and its header takes the opaque sheet tone so rows can scroll under it

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: headers are secondary at label size and numbers are set at the end in tabular figures

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: a sortable header is a button that fills its 44px header cell and says its order with aria-sort

options: A pane with an opaque header
variants.picked: A pane with an opaque header
variants.reason: A keeps the data the loudest thing (P3, P2). B brings hue. C draws a grid around every value.

root.why: the table sits on a level-2 pane that scrolls in both directions as a named focusable region

table.why: the table fills the pane and keeps separate borders so the sticky header keeps its line

caption.why: the caption names the table above it at label size when it is shown

hidden.why: a hidden caption is still read so every table has a name for screen readers

th.why: headers are secondary at label size on the opaque sheet tone and stay in view

td.why: cells share one padding and a hairline under each row in the divider tone

tr.why: a row lights under the pointer so the eye can follow it across many columns

comfortable.why: the comfortable density gives every row at least a 44px height

compact.why: the compact density trims the cell padding for dense data read with a pointer

end.why: numbers are set at the end in tabular figures so their digits line up

sort.why: the sort button fills its header cell so the whole header is the press area

glyph.why: the sort arrow is faint until its column is sorted, then it points the way

on.why: the sorted column shows its arrow at full strength in the primary tone

desc.why: a descending sort turns the same arrow over so one glyph shows both orders

empty.why: a table with no rows says so in one quiet line across the body instead of showing a blank grid

loading.why: while rows load they stay under a scrim that says so, so the reader keeps their place

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and the fill so the parts stay findable

hover.why: a row takes the quiet surface under the pointer so it can be followed across columns

focus-visible.why: the scrolling region and each sort button show the focus ring when reached by keyboard

data-pane-card.why: inside a Card the card glass already blurs and dims the scene, so this drops its own filter and stays the inner level

data-pane-surface.why: inside any other pane that marks itself a surface it likewise drops its own filter and stays the inner level

background-color.why: the row highlight fades in on the hover ease instead of flashing
